items.source: The use of a raw target ConnectionFactory would not only be inefficient because of the lack of resource reuse. It might also lead to strange effects when your JMS driver doesn't accept MessageProducer.close() calls and/or MessageConsumer.close() calls before Session.commit(), with the latter supposed to commit all the messages that have been sent through the producer handle and received through the consumer handle. As a safe general solution, always pass in a CachingConnectionFactory into this transaction manager's "connectionFactory" property.
items.translation: 使用 raw 目标 ConnectionFactory 不仅会因为缺乏资源重用而导致效率低下，还可能在您的 JMS 驱动程序在 Session.commit() 之前不接受 MessageProducer.close() 和/或 MessageConsumer.close() 调用时导致奇怪的效果，后者本应提交通过生产者句柄发送且通过消费者句柄接收的所有消息。作为安全的通用解决方案，始终将 CachingConnectionFactory 传递给此事务管理器的 "connectionFactory" 属性。

items.source: Application code is required to retrieve the transactional JMS Session via ConnectionFactoryUtils.getTransactionalSession(ConnectionFactory, Connection, boolean) instead of a standard Jakarta EE-style ConnectionFactory.createConnection() call with subsequent Session creation. Spring's JmsTemplate will autodetect a thread-bound Session and automatically participate in it.
items.translation: 应用程序代码需要通过ConnectionFactoryUtils.getTransactionalSession(ConnectionFactory, Connection, boolean)检索事务性 JMS Session，而不是使用标准的 Jakarta EE 风格ConnectionFactory.createConnection()调用及随后的 Session 创建。Spring 的JmsTemplate将自动检测线程绑定的 Session 并自动参与其中。

items.source: This local strategy is an alternative to executing JMS operations within JTA transactions. Its advantage is that it is able to work in any environment, for example a standalone application or a test suite, with any message broker as target. However, this strategy is not able to provide XA transactions, for example in order to share transactions between messaging and database access. A full JTA/XA setup is required for XA transactions, typically using Spring's JtaTransactionManager as strategy.
items.translation: 此本地策略是替代在 JTA 事务中执行 JMS 操作的一种方案。其优势在于能够在任何环境中工作，例如独立应用程序或测试套件，并将任何消息代理作为目标。然而，此策略无法提供 XA 事务，例如用于在消息传递和数据库访问之间共享事务。XA 事务需要完整的 JTA/XA 设置，通常使用 Spring 的JtaTransactionManager作为策略。

items.source: The use of CachingConnectionFactory as a target for this transaction manager is strongly recommended. CachingConnectionFactory uses a single JMS Connection for all JMS access in order to avoid the overhead of repeated Connection creation, as well as maintaining a cache of Sessions. Each transaction will then share the same JMS Connection, while still using its own individual JMS Session.
items.translation: 强烈建议使用 CachingConnectionFactory 作为此事务管理器的目标。 CachingConnectionFactory 使用单个 JMS 连接来处理所有 JMS 访问，以避免重复创建连接的开销，并维护一个会话缓存。每个事务将共享相同的 JMS 连接，同时仍使用其各自的独立 JMS 会话。

items.source: Alternatively, you can allow application code to work with the standard Jakarta EE-style lookup pattern on a ConnectionFactory, for example for legacy code that is not aware of Spring at all. In that case, define a TransactionAwareConnectionFactoryProxy for your target ConnectionFactory, which will automatically participate in Spring-managed transactions.
items.translation: 或者，您可以允许应用程序代码在 `ConnectionFactory` 上使用标准的 Jakarta EE 风格查找模式，例如针对完全不感知 Spring 的遗留代码。在这种情况下，为您的目标 `ConnectionFactory` 定义一个 `TransactionAwareConnectionFactoryProxy`，它将自动参与由 Spring 管理的事务。

items.source: Transaction synchronization is turned off by default, as this manager might be used alongside a datastore-based Spring transaction manager such as the JDBC DataSourceTransactionManager, which has stronger needs for synchronization.
items.translation: 默认情况下，事务同步被禁用，因为此管理器可能会与基于数据存储的 Spring 事务管理器（如 JDBC DataSourceTransactionManager）一起使用，后者对同步有更强的需求。

items.source:
Note: The ConnectionFactory has to be set before using the instance.
This constructor can be used to prepare a JmsTemplate via a BeanFactory,
typically setting the ConnectionFactory via setConnectionFactory.
items.translation: 注意：在使用实例之前，必须设置 ConnectionFactory。此构造函数可用于通过 BeanFactory 准备 JmsTemplate，通常通过 setConnectionFactory 设置 ConnectionFactory。

items.source:
Turns off transaction synchronization by default, as this manager might
be used alongside a datastore-based Spring transaction manager like
DataSourceTransactionManager, which has stronger needs for synchronization.
Only one manager is allowed to drive synchronization at any point of time.
items.translation: 默认关闭事务同步，因为此管理器可能与基于数据源的 Spring 事务管理器（如 DataSourceTransactionManager）一起使用，后者对同步有更强的需求。在任何时间点，只允许一个管理器驱动同步。

items.translation: 默认实现会抛出 `TransactionSuspensionNotSupportedException`，假定事务挂起通常不受支持。

items.source: Specify whether this transaction manager should lazily retrieve a JMS Connection and Session on access within a transaction (true). By default, it will eagerly create a JMS Connection and Session at transaction begin (false).

items.source: This target resource factory is usually used as resource key for TransactionSynchronizationManager's resource bindings per thread.
items.translation: 此目标资源工厂通常用作线程级资源绑定的资源键，用于 TransactionSynchronizationManager。

items.source: The returned object should contain information about any existing transaction, that is, a transaction that has already started before the current getTransaction call on the transaction manager. Consequently, a doGetTransaction implementation will usually look for an existing transaction and store corresponding state in the returned transaction object.
items.translation: 返回的对象应包含有关任何现有事务的信息，即在当前对事务管理器的 `getTransaction` 调用之前已经启动的事务。因此，`doGetTransaction` 的实现通常会查找现有事务，并将相应的状态存储在返回的事务对象中。

items.source: Called after doCommit and doRollback execution, on any outcome. The default implementation does nothing.
items.translation: 在 `doCommit` 和 `doRollback` 执行后，无论结果如何都会调用。默认实现什么都不做。

items.source: The default implementation returns false, assuming that participating in existing transactions is generally not supported. Subclasses are of course encouraged to provide such support.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 `false`，假设通常不支持参与现有事务。当然鼓励子类提供此类支持。

items.source: A special scenario is a nested transaction without savepoint: If useSavepointForNestedTransaction() returns "false", this method will be called to start a nested transaction when necessary. In such a context, there will be an active transaction: The implementation of this method has to detect this and start an appropriate nested transaction.
items.translation: 特殊场景是指不带保存点的嵌套事务：如果useSavepointForNestedTransaction()返回"false"，则会在必要时调用此方法以启动嵌套事务。在此类上下文中，将存在一个活动事务：此方法的实现必须检测这一点并启动适当的嵌套事务。

items.source:
The returned object will usually be specific to the concrete transaction
manager implementation, carrying corresponding transaction state in a
modifiable fashion. This object will be passed into the other template
methods (for example, doBegin and doCommit), either directly or as part of a
DefaultTransactionStatus instance.
items.translation: 返回的对象通常针对具体的事务管理器实现，以可修改的方式承载相应的事务状态。该对象将直接作为参数传入其他模板方法（例如 doBegin 和 doCommit），或者作为 DefaultTransactionStatus 实例的一部分传入。

items.source:
The result will be evaluated according to the specified propagation
behavior for the new transaction. An existing transaction might get
suspended (in case of PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW), or the new transaction
might participate in the existing one (in case of PROPAGATION_REQUIRED).
items.translation: 结果将根据新事务指定的传播行为进行评估。现有事务可能会被挂起（在 PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW 的情况下），或者新事务可能会参与现有事务（在 PROPAGATION_REQUIRED 的情况下）。

items.source:
This method gets called when the transaction manager has decided to actually
start a new transaction. Either there wasn't any transaction before, or the
previous transaction has been suspended.
items.translation: 此方法在事务管理器决定实际开始一个新事务时被调用。要么之前没有事务，要么之前的交易已被挂起。

items.source:
An implementation does not need to check the "new transaction" flag
or the rollback-only flag; this will already have been handled before.
Usually, a straight commit will be performed on the transaction object
contained in the passed-in status.
items.translation: 实现无需检查“新事务”标志或回滚专用标志；这些在此之前已经处理过。通常，将在传入状态中包含的事务对象上执行直接提交。
实现无需检查“新事务”标志；该标志此前已处理。通常，将对传入状态中包含的事务对象执行直接回滚。

items.source:
The default implementation throws an IllegalTransactionStateException,
assuming that participating in existing transactions is generally not
supported. Subclasses are of course encouraged to provide such support.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出 `IllegalTransactionStateException`，假定参与现有事务通常不受支持。当然，鼓励子类提供此类支持。

items.source: Should not throw any exceptions but just issue warnings on errors.
items.translation: 不应抛出任何异常，而应在出错时仅发出警告。
